panel_a.description: All five arena models pooled. Each TALK response is classified by the agent's own margin at that moment = how many times its tokens could pay the per-agent fine. Percent of responses containing a GIVE and percent containing an EXIT, with Wilson 95% intervals at the response level. Bands ordered from plenty to short.

panel_b.description: Single-question refill experiment outside the arena: share of 20 calls that used the one refill pack, at five levels of remaining allocation (50,40,30,20,10 percent of 100,000). Eight models. Highlight GPT-6 Luna (earliest) and GPT-6 Sol (latest); others gray.

panel_c.description: Same refill decision asked about the model's own session (self) and about another AI assistant B's session. Area between the two curves over 10-50 percent remaining, self minus B, in percentage points, with bootstrap 95% interval. Positive = favours itself. Verdict against three criteria set after seeing the data (exploratory).
